newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares slip in directionless trade at end.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares slip in directionless trade at end.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket closed lower on Monday with trade quiet and directionless for most of the day but picking up a bit in late trade when New York opened.
The Stockholm general index slipped 0.13 percent to 2,134.69 after shares worth 3.2 billion crowns changed owners.
One broker said the market was treading water ahead of the FOMC meeting on Wednesday with a lack of domestic news as the nine month reporting seasons start to wind down.
Bluechip stocks were mixed. Ericsson started the day with gains but closed one crown lower at 193.50 crowns.
Brokers said the market was waiting for Finnish rival Nokia's results on Thursday.
Drugs major Astra closed steady at 291.50 crowns.
The market was watching for forestry company AssiDoman and tool maker and engineer Sandvik to report their nine month results on Tuesday.
